basic_details.short_information: Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani (BITS Pilani) Research Fellow Notification 2026 has been released on 21 July 2026 on the official website of Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani (BITS Pilani). A total of 2 vacancies have been announced through the BITS Pilani Research Fellow Recruitment 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BITS Pilani Research Fellow Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BITS Pilani to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BITS Pilani Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BITS Pilani to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the BITS Pilani Research Fellow positions is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Post Graduate or Graduate degree in Electronics/Communication/Instrumentation/Computer Science/EEE or an equivalent discipline from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for BITS Pilani Research Fellow jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online through the official BITS Pilani website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary shortlisting based on the resume and a telephonic/audio-visual interview, followed by a final interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the BITS Pilani campus located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the BITS Pilani campus located in Goa.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Fellow positions are contractual roles.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article.
